researchTasks: [High] Output ownership, exact age, admin role matrix and platform retention: Please provide exact model/version by feature, minimum age/consent, ownership terms, platform retention and a role matrix for teachers/admins to view chats and set limits. (route: Vendor privacy/security contact; evidence wanted: Terms, DPA, subprocessor list, admin guide, retention schedule)

Confirm current pricing, market availability, integrations/standards, accessibility, security evidence and commercial relationship. Complete blank AI fields from current vendor terms/help/trust documentation; record a separate source per field.
Ask vendor (Minimum learner age): What age ranges are supported and what parental consent is required for younger learners?
Ask vendor (Staff can review AI output before learners see it): Please provide a current admin/teacher permission matrix for student chat visibility, limits and pre-publication review.
Ask vendor (How it responds to learners): Is the AI designed to coach learners with questions/hints, follow educator-defined behaviour, or provide direct answers? Can this be configured?
Ask vendor (Answers from your own course content): Can the AI answer from customer-provided course content or institutional knowledge? Can this be restricted to approved content?
Ask vendor (Shows its sources): Does the AI show citations or source references for answers grounded in uploaded/course content?
Ask vendor (Who owns what the AI produces): Who owns teacher-created Spaces, student prompts and AI-generated outputs?
Researcher note (dataPrivacy), not shown until sourced: Distinguish SchoolAI platform retention from model-provider retention. District can request deletion.
Researcher note (learnerOversight), not shown until sourced: Teacher dashboard and student conversation visibility are core platform controls; exact per-plan visibility should be confirmed.

Researcher note (outputOwnership), not shown until sourced: Vendor states providers do not retain prompts and do not train on them; district-generated data is retained by SchoolAI for service operation and can be deleted on request.
